benchmark.promotion_rule: semantic overall >= baseline +0.15 with no >0.10 drop in originality or evidence handling

interpretation: Top-6 semantic retrieval did not improve the blinded synthetic benchmark and must not be enabled in production.
reproducibility_note: The validated earlier 25-episode extraction contained 227 neutral mechanics; this regeneration produced 231. Future corpus promotion should use a frozen derived mechanics snapshot rather than repeated model extraction.
